title: At the Station, and When Things Go Wrong
label: ch:sa-at-the-station-and-when-things-go-wrong
canDo: I can ask for tickets and when the next train leaves (ekaṃ yānapatraṃ dadātu; agrimaṃ dhūmayānaṃ kadā?), and say what went wrong (mama syūtaḥ naṣṭaḥ; dhūmayānaṃ gatam; ahaṃ rugṇaḥ asmi).

payoff.summary: Complete SA-R281-at-the-station: buy a ticket, ask when the train leaves, and say what went wrong.
